examples.text: When the two-dimensional curve is a circle, the cylinder is called a circular cylinder. When the axis is perpendicular to the plane of the curve, the cylinder is called a right cylinder. In non-mathematical usage, both right and circular are usually implied.

raw_glosses: (geometry) A surface created by projecting a closed two-dimensional curve along an axis intersecting the plane of the curve.
glosses: A surface created by projecting a closed two-dimensional curve along an axis intersecting the plane of the curve.

raw_glosses: (geometry) A solid figure bounded by a cylinder and two parallel planes intersecting the cylinder.
glosses: A solid figure bounded by a cylinder and two parallel planes intersecting the cylinder.

examples.text: A big greyish rounded bulk, the size, perhaps, of a bear, was rising slowly and painfully out of the cylinder.
examples.ref: 1898, H. G. Wells, chapter 4, in The War of the Worlds:

glosses: Any object in the form of a circular cylinder.
A cylindrical cavity or chamber in a mechanism, such as the counterpart to a piston found in a piston-driven engine.

raw_glosses: (automotive) The space in which a piston travels inside a reciprocating engine or pump.
glosses: The space in which a piston travels inside a reciprocating engine or pump.
A container in the form of a cylinder with rounded ends for storing pressurized gas; a gas cylinder.
An early form of phonograph recording, made on a wax cylinder.
The part of a revolver that contains chambers for the cartridges.

raw_glosses: (computing) The corresponding tracks on a vertical arrangement of disks in a disk drive considered as a unit of data capacity.
glosses: The corresponding tracks on a vertical arrangement of disks in a disk drive considered as a unit of data capacity.

examples.text: Where rectangular storage containers make a mess of mismatched lids and sometimes unstackable shapes, the ordinary cylindrical deli cups used for food delivery are far superior.
examples.ref: 2019 April 3, Janelle Zara, “How to Organize Your Kitchen Like a Professional Chef”, in The New York Times Magazine, archived from the original on 17 Jul 2020:

raw_glosses: (cartography) Describing a map projection in which meridians are mapped onto vertical lines and parallels of latitude onto horizontal lines.
glosses: Describing a map projection in which meridians are mapped onto vertical lines and parallels of latitude onto horizontal lines.

raw_glosses: (uncountable, geometry) The quality of being cylindrical.
(countable, geometry) A three-dimensional geometric tolerance that controls how much a feature can deviate from a perfect cylinder.
glosses: A three-dimensional geometric tolerance that controls how much a feature can deviate from a perfect cylinder.
